records.literal_gloss: And came Rehoboam [to] Jerusalem, and he assembled [the] house of Judah and Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand chosen [men], doers of war, to fight with Israel, to bring back the kingdom to Rehoboam.

en.L: And Rehoboam came [to] Jerusalem and assembled the house of Judah and Benjamin, 180,000 chosen [men], makers of war, to fight with Israel, to bring back the kingdom to Rehoboam.
en.B: When Rehoboam arrived in Jerusalem, he mustered the house of Judah and Benjamin, 180,000 picked warriors, to fight against Israel and regain the kingdom for Rehoboam.
en.R: When Rehoboam got back to Jerusalem, he gathered 180,000 of the best soldiers from the people of Judah and Benjamin. He wanted to fight against Israel and win back the kingdom for himself.

es.L: Y llegó Roboam [a] Jerusalén y reunió a la casa de Judá y Benjamín, 180 000 [hombres] escogidos, hacedores de guerra, para pelear contra Israel, para devolver el reino a Roboam.
es.B: Cuando Roboam llegó a Jerusalén, convocó a la casa de Judá y Benjamín, 180 000 guerreros escogidos, para pelear contra Israel y recuperar el reino para Roboam.
es.R: Cuando Roboam volvió a Jerusalén, reunió a 180 000 de los mejores soldados del pueblo de Judá y de Benjamín. Quería pelear contra Israel y recuperar el reino para sí mismo.

fr.L: Et Roboam vint [à] Jérusalem, et il rassembla la maison de Juda et de Benjamin, 180 000 [hommes] choisis, faiseurs de guerre, pour combattre contre Israël, pour ramener la royauté à Roboam.
fr.B: Arrivé à Jérusalem, Roboam rassembla la maison de Juda et de Benjamin, 180 000 guerriers d’élite, pour combattre Israël et reconquérir le royaume pour Roboam.
fr.R: Quand Roboam est arrivé à Jérusalem, il a rassemblé 180 000 des meilleurs soldats du peuple de Juda et de Benjamin. Il voulait faire la guerre à Israël et reprendre le royaume pour lui-même.

sw.L: Rehoboamu akafika Yerusalemu, akaikusanya nyumba ya Yuda na Benyamini, [watu] 180,000 waliochaguliwa, watendaji wa vita, ili kupigana na Israeli, kuurudisha ufalme kwa Rehoboamu.
sw.B: Rehoboamu alipofika Yerusalemu, aliikusanya nyumba ya Yuda na Benyamini, wapiganaji hodari 180,000 waliochaguliwa, ili kupigana na Israeli na kumrudishia Rehoboamu ufalme.
sw.R: Rehoboamu aliporudi Yerusalemu, aliwakusanya askari bora 180,000 kutoka kwa watu wa Yuda na Benyamini. Alitaka kupigana na Israeli na kuurudisha ufalme kwake mwenyewe.

vi.L: Rô-bô-am đến Giê-ru-sa-lem, tập hợp nhà Giu-đa và Bên-gia-min, 180.000 [người] tuyển chọn, là những người thạo việc chiến trận, để giao chiến với Y-sơ-ra-ên, để đem vương quốc trở về cho Rô-bô-am.
vi.B: Khi về đến Giê-ru-sa-lem, Rô-bô-am triệu tập nhà Giu-đa và Bên-gia-min, được 180.000 chiến binh tinh nhuệ, để đánh Y-sơ-ra-ên và giành lại vương quốc cho Rô-bô-am.
vi.R: Khi về tới Giê-ru-sa-lem, Rô-bô-am tập hợp 180.000 binh sĩ giỏi nhất từ dân Giu-đa và Bên-gia-min. Ông muốn đánh Y-sơ-ra-ên để giành lại vương quốc cho chính mình.

ko.L: 그리고 르호보암이 예루살렘에 와서 유다의 집과 베냐민, 곧 전쟁을 하는 자들 가운데 뽑힌 [자] 18만 명을 모아, 이스라엘과 싸워 나라를 르호보암에게 되돌리려 했다.
ko.B: 르호보암은 예루살렘에 돌아오자 유다 집안과 베냐민에서 뽑힌 용사 18만 명을 불러 모았다. 이스라엘과 싸워서 나라를 르호보암에게 되찾아 오려는 것이었다.
ko.R: 르호보암은 예루살렘에 돌아오자, 유다와 베냐민 백성 가운데서 가장 뛰어난 군인 18만 명을 모았다. 그는 이스라엘과 싸워서 나라를 다시 자기 것으로 되찾으려고 했다.

decisions.choice: the same account as 1 Kings 12:21, with small differences
decisions.reason: Verses 1-4 retell 1 Kings 12:21-24 almost word for word. Here the text says "the house of Judah and Benjamin" where Kings has "all the house of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin"; it says "Israel" where Kings has "the house of Israel"; it uses a different word for "kingdom" (Kings has a word closer to "kingship"); and it ends with "to Rehoboam" without "son of Solomon". The sense is the same.

decisions.choice: 180,000: "thousand" as written
decisions.reason: The number is given as the Hebrew has it. As in the census lists of Numbers (see the note at Numbers 1:21), the word for "thousand" can also name a military unit, which would make the force much smaller.

decisions.choice: chosen men, makers of war: picked fighting men
decisions.reason: "Chosen" means men picked for service, usually young and fit; "makers of war" means trained soldiers.

decisions.choice: to bring back the kingdom: to reunite the tribes under Rehoboam
decisions.reason: The northern tribes had just rejected Rehoboam and made their own way (10:16-19). Rehoboam means to win them back by force.

decisions.choice: for himself
decisions.reason: Readable splits the long sentence and makes clear that Rehoboam meant to win back the kingdom for himself, as at 1 Kings 12:21.

decisions.choice: wording of 1 Kings 12:21-24 kept
decisions.reason: Verses 1-4 retell 1 Kings 12:21-24 almost word for word (meaning decision); the Spanish Kings wording is kept at each level, with the changes the Hebrew makes.

decisions.choice: the wording of 1 Kings 12:21-24 for verses 1-4
decisions.reason: Verses 1-4 retell 1 Kings 12:21-24 (m1); the Vietnamese of Kings is kept, changing only what Chronicles changes. Literal writes the number in figures here, as the English does.

decisions.choice: The wording of 1 Kings 12:21-24 at each level; the number in figures, "18만 명"
decisions.reason: Verses 1-4 retell 1 Kings 12:21-24; the Korean repeats Kings and changes only what the Hebrew changes.

vi.B: Nhưng lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến với Sê-ma-gia, người của Đức Chúa Trời:
vi.R: Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban sứ điệp này cho Sê-ma-gia, người của Đức Chúa Trời:

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 하나님의 사람 스마야에게 임하여 말씀하셨다.

ko.R: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하나님의 사람 스마야에게 이렇게 말씀하셨다.

decisions.choice: the word of the LORD: Kings has "the word of God"
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 12:22 says "the word of God"; Chronicles uses the divine name. It also spells Shemaiah's name in its longer form, ending in -yahu; it is the same name and the same man.

decisions.choice: the man of God: a prophet
decisions.reason: "Man of God" is a title for a prophet who speaks God's word (1 Samuel 2:27; 9:6-10). Shemaiah appears again in 12:5-8, 15.

decisions.choice: but: God stops the war
decisions.reason: The word of the LORD comes just as Rehoboam is ready to march, and it turns the story.

decisions.choice: "vino la palabra del SEÑOR a" (L, B); "el SEÑOR le dio este mensaje" (R)
decisions.reason: Chronicles has the divine name where 1 Kings 12:22 has "God" (meaning decision); the formula follows the Kings terms note for Spanish.

decisions.choice: all Israel in Judah and Benjamin: Kings has "all the house of Judah and Benjamin and the rest of the people"
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 12:23 addresses "all the house of Judah and Benjamin and the rest of the people". Chronicles says instead "all Israel in Judah and Benjamin". The people addressed are the same: those who stayed with Rehoboam.

decisions.choice: all Israel: the people of Israel living in the southern kingdom
decisions.reason: Chronicles keeps the name Israel for the whole people of God, even for those living in Judah and Benjamin (10:17; 11:13, 16). The ten northern tribes have broken away, but the Israelites in the south are still "all Israel" in God's eyes.

decisions.choice: king of Judah: God's word names Rehoboam king of Judah only
decisions.reason: Rehoboam is called "king of Judah", not king of Israel. God's message itself accepts the division of the kingdom.

decisions.choice: all the people of Israel who live in
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly that "all Israel" here means the people living in Judah and Benjamin.

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh, Not you shall go up and not you shall fight with your brothers; return each to his house, for from with me has come about the thing the this. And they listened to [the] words of Yahweh and turned back from going against Jeroboam.

en.L: 'Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: You shall not go up, and you shall not fight with your brothers. Return, each man to his house, for this thing has come about from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.'" And they listened to the words of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and turned back from going against Jeroboam.
en.B: '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: Do not go up to fight against your relatives. Go home, every one of you, for this thing has come from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.'" So they heeded the words of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and turned back from marching against Jeroboam.
en.R: 'This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: Do not go to war against your relatives. All of you go home. I am the one who made this happen.'" So they obeyed the words of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. They turned back and did not attack Jeroboam.

es.L: “Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: No {{plural_you:subirán ni pelearán|subiréis ni pelearéis}} contra {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hermanos. {{plural_you:Vuelvan|Volved}} cada uno a su casa, porque de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} ha venido esto”». Y escucharon las palabras {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y desistieron de ir contra Jeroboam.
es.B: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: No {{plural_you:suban|subáis}} a pelear contra {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} parientes. {{plural_you:Vuelvan|Volved}} a casa cada uno, porque esto ha venido de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}”». Así que obedecieron las palabras {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y desistieron de marchar contra Jeroboam.
es.R: “Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: No {{plural_you:vayan|vayáis}} a la guerra contra {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} parientes. {{plural_you:Vuelvan|Volved}} todos a casa. Yo soy quien hizo que esto sucediera”». Así que obedecieron las palabras {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Se volvieron y no atacaron a Jeroboam.

fr.L: “Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Vous ne monterez pas et vous ne combattrez pas contre vos frères. Retournez chacun dans sa maison, car c’est de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} que cette chose est venue.” » Et ils écoutèrent les paroles {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et ils renoncèrent à marcher contre Jéroboam.
fr.B: “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Ne montez pas combattre contre vos frères. Rentrez chacun chez vous, car c’est de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} que vient ce qui est arrivé.” » Ils obéirent aux paroles {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et renoncèrent à marcher contre Jéroboam.
fr.R: “Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : N’allez pas faire la guerre contre vos frères. Rentrez tous chez vous. C’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui ai fait arriver tout cela.” » Ils ont donc obéi aux paroles {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Ils ont fait demi-tour et ils n’ont pas attaqué Jéroboam.

sw.L: '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Msipande, wala msipigane na ndugu zenu. Rudini, kila mtu nyumbani kwake, kwa maana jambo hili limetoka {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}.'" Wakayasikiliza maneno ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wakarudi wasiende juu ya Yeroboamu.
sw.B: 'Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Msiende kupigana na ndugu zenu. Rudini nyumbani, kila mmoja wenu, kwa maana jambo hili limetoka {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}.'" Basi wakayatii maneno ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wakarudi wasiende kumshambulia Yeroboamu.
sw.R: 'Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Msiende vitani kupigana na ndugu zenu. Nyote rudini nyumbani. Mimi ndiye niliyefanya jambo hili litokee.'" Basi wakayatii maneno ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Wakarudi, wala hawakumshambulia Yeroboamu.

vi.L: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Các ngươi chớ đi lên, và chớ giao chiến với anh em mình. Mỗi người hãy trở về nhà mình, vì việc này đến từ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'" Họ nghe lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và quay về, không đi đánh Giê-rô-bô-am.
vi.B: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Đừng đi lên đánh anh em bà con của các ngươi. Mọi người hãy trở về nhà, vì việc này là do {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'" Vậy họ vâng theo lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và quay về, không kéo quân đánh Giê-rô-bô-am nữa.
vi.R: 'Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Đừng đi đánh anh em bà con của các ngươi. Mọi người hãy về nhà đi. Chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm cho việc này xảy ra.'" Vậy họ vâng theo lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Họ quay về và không tấn công Giê-rô-bô-am.

ko.L: '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 너희는 올라가지 말고, 너희 형제들과 싸우지 말아라. 각 사람은 자기 집으로 돌아가라. 이 일은 나에게서 나온 것이다.'" 그러자 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 듣고, 여로보암에게로 가는 것에서 돌아섰다.
ko.B: '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 너희 친척들과 싸우러 올라가지 말아라. 모두 자기 집으로 돌아가라. 이 일은 내가 일으킨 것이다.'" 그러자 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 듣고 여로보암을 치러 가던 길에서 돌아섰다.
ko.R: '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 너희 친척들과 싸우러 가지 말아라. 모두 집으로 돌아가라. 이 일은 내가 일어나게 한 것이다.'" 그러자 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀에 순종했다. 그들은 돌아섰고 여로보암을 치지 않았다.

decisions.choice: the same as 1 Kings 12:24, with three differences
decisions.reason: Kings says "your brothers, the sons of Israel"; Chronicles has only "your brothers". Kings says "the word of the LORD"; Chronicles has "the words". And where Kings ends "they turned back to go home, as the LORD had said", Chronicles ends "they turned back from going against Jeroboam".

decisions.choice: this has come from me: the LORD owns the division
decisions.reason: As 10:15 says, the split of the kingdom was brought about by God. To fight it would be to fight against him.

decisions.choice: your brothers: your own kin
decisions.reason: "Brothers" here means fellow members of one people, descended from Jacob's sons. The war would be a war within one family.

decisions.choice: go up and fight: march to war
decisions.reason: To "go up" is often to set out on a campaign; the two verbs together mean "march out to fight".

decisions.choice: relatives
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "relatives" to show that "brothers" means kin, as at 1 Kings 12:24; Literal keeps "brothers".

decisions.choice: Thus says the LORD; The LORD says this; This is what the LORD says
decisions.reason: The prophet's formula is worded the same way at each level throughout Samuel, Kings and Chronicles.

decisions.choice: "Así dice el SEÑOR" (L); "El SEÑOR dice esto" (B); "Esto es lo que dice el SEÑOR" (R)
decisions.reason: The messenger formula as the Samuel note sets for Spanish, one wording per level, as in the Spanish of 1 Kings 12:24.

decisions.choice: "Ainsi parle le SEIGNEUR" (L); "Le SEIGNEUR dit ceci" (B); "Voici ce que dit le SEIGNEUR" (R); "vos frères"
decisions.reason: The prophet's formula of the Samuel note, as in French Kings (1 Kings 12:24). French keeps "frères" at every level: "vos frères" says plainly that the northern tribes are their own kin, where the English says "relatives".

decisions.choice: BWANA asema hivi (Literal); Hivi ndivyo BWANA asemavyo (Balanced); Hili ndilo BWANA analosema (Readable)
decisions.reason: The prophets' formula keeps one wording per level through Samuel, Kings and Chronicles.

decisions.choice: "CHÚA phán thế này" (L); "CHÚA phán như vầy" (B); "Đây là lời CHÚA phán" (R)
decisions.reason: The prophet's formula of the Samuel terms note, kept through Chronicles.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다" (L), "이렇게 말씀하신다" (B), "하시는 말씀이다" (R)
decisions.reason: The messenger formula as in the Korean Samuel and Kings; Korean uses no deity_pronoun span for "from me".

decisions.choice: Zorah, Aijalon, Hebron
decisions.reason: Zorah and Aijalon guarded valleys leading up from the coastal plain in the northwest (Joshua 19:41-42; Judges 13:2). Hebron was the old chief city of Judah, where David first reigned (2 Samuel 2:1-4).

decisions.choice: a ring of strongholds on the east, south and west
decisions.reason: The fifteen cities lie to the east, south and west of Jerusalem; none is on the northern border with Israel. The text does not say why. Perhaps Rehoboam feared attack from Egypt and the coastal plain more than from Israel; Shishak king of Egypt took Judah's fortified cities a few years later (12:2-4).

decisions.choice: in Judah and in Benjamin: the whole southern kingdom
decisions.reason: Judah and Benjamin together make up Rehoboam's kingdom (verses 1, 3, 12, 23).

decisions.choice: These were fortified cities
decisions.reason: Readable ends the list and says what the cities were in a short sentence of its own.

decisions.reason: The towns take the French forms already used in these books (Bethléem, Soko, Gath, Ziph, Lakish, Hébron) and, for the others, the same pattern: "ts" for tsade, "ou" for u, "q" for qof, a circumflex on a long final syllable.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 요새들을 튼튼하게 하고 그 안에 지휘관들을 두고, 양식과 기름과 포도주를 쌓아 두었다.
ko.B: 그는 요새들을 튼튼하게 하고 그 안에 지휘관들을 두었으며, 양식과 기름과 포도주를 쌓아 두었다.
ko.R: 그는 요새들을 튼튼하게 했다. 요새마다 지휘관을 한 사람씩 두어 책임을 맡기고, 양식과 올리브기름과 포도주를 쌓아 두었다.

decisions.choice: rulers: officers in charge of each fortress
decisions.reason: The word usually means a ruler or leader; here, in the plural, it names the men placed in charge of the strongholds.

decisions.choice: food, oil and wine: supplies for a siege
decisions.reason: A fortified city had to be able to feed its people and soldiers if an enemy surrounded it. Oil is olive oil, used for food and for lamps.

decisions.choice: rulers (Literal); commanders (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "rulers", the usual word for this title in these books. Balanced says "commanders", because these are military officers over the forts.

decisions.choice: an officer in charge of each one; olive oil
decisions.reason: Readable says what the commanders did and what kind of oil is meant.

source.text: וּבְכָל־עִ֤יר וָעִיר֙ צִנּ֣וֹת וּרְמָחִ֔ים וַֽיְחַזְּקֵ֖ם לְהַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וַיְהִי־ל֖וֹ יְהוּדָ֥ה וּבִנְיָמִֽן׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And in every city and city [were] shields and spears, and he strengthened them to make great exceedingly. And was to him Judah and Benjamin.

en.L: And in every single city [were] large shields and spears, and he made them exceedingly strong. And Judah and Benjamin were his.
en.B: In every city he placed large shields and spears and made the cities very strong. So Judah and Benjamin remained his.
en.R: In every city he stored large shields and spears, and he made the cities very strong. So Judah and Benjamin stayed under his rule.

es.L: Y en todas y cada una de las ciudades [había] escudos grandes y lanzas, y las fortaleció en gran manera. Y Judá y Benjamín fueron suyos.
es.B: En cada ciudad puso escudos grandes y lanzas, y las hizo muy fuertes. Así Judá y Benjamín siguieron siendo suyos.
es.R: En cada ciudad guardó escudos grandes y lanzas, e hizo las ciudades muy fuertes. Así Judá y Benjamín siguieron bajo su gobierno.

fr.L: Et dans chaque ville, [il y avait] des grands boucliers et des lances, et il les rendit extrêmement fortes. Et Juda et Benjamin furent à lui.
fr.B: Dans chaque ville, il mit de grands boucliers et des lances, et il rendit les villes très fortes. Ainsi Juda et Benjamin restèrent à lui.
fr.R: Dans chaque ville, il a entreposé de grands boucliers et des lances, et il a rendu les villes très solides. Ainsi Juda et Benjamin sont restés sous son autorité.

sw.L: Na katika kila mji [kulikuwa na] ngao kubwa na mikuki, akaifanya [miji] kuwa imara mno. Na Yuda na Benyamini walikuwa wake.
sw.B: Katika kila mji aliweka ngao kubwa na mikuki, akaifanya miji kuwa imara sana. Hivyo Yuda na Benyamini wakabaki kuwa wake.
sw.R: Katika kila mji alihifadhi ngao kubwa na mikuki, akaifanya miji kuwa imara sana. Hivyo Yuda na Benyamini wakabaki chini ya utawala wake.

vi.L: Trong mỗi thành [có] khiên lớn và giáo, và vua làm cho các thành ấy rất vững mạnh. Giu-đa và Bên-gia-min thuộc về vua.
vi.B: Trong mỗi thành vua đặt khiên lớn và giáo, và làm cho các thành ấy rất vững mạnh. Vậy Giu-đa và Bên-gia-min vẫn thuộc về vua.
vi.R: Trong mỗi thành vua cất giữ khiên lớn và giáo, và làm cho các thành ấy rất vững mạnh. Vậy Giu-đa và Bên-gia-min vẫn ở dưới quyền cai trị của vua.

ko.L: 그리고 성읍마다 큰 방패와 창을 [두고], 그것들을 매우 강하게 했다. 그리고 유다와 베냐민이 그의 것이었다.
ko.B: 그는 성읍마다 큰 방패와 창을 두어 성읍들을 매우 튼튼하게 했다. 이렇게 하여 유다와 베냐민은 그의 나라가 되었다.
ko.R: 그는 성읍마다 큰 방패와 창을 쌓아 두고, 성읍들을 매우 튼튼하게 했다. 그래서 유다와 베냐민은 그의 다스림 아래 있었다.

decisions.choice: shields: large shields covering the whole body
decisions.reason: The word names the large shield a soldier could stand behind, not the small round shield. With spears, it was the equipment of the heavy infantry (14:7).

decisions.choice: every city and city: each city, one by one
decisions.reason: Repeating the noun stresses that not one city was left out.

decisions.choice: made them strong: the cities
decisions.reason: "Them" most naturally refers to the fortified cities of verses 10-11, which Rehoboam made very strong.

decisions.choice: Judah and Benjamin were his: he held them
decisions.reason: The closing words sum up verses 5-12: while the northern tribes had gone, Judah and Benjamin stayed firmly under Rehoboam.

decisions.choice: placed; stored
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has no verb in the first clause; Balanced and Readable supply one to show that Rehoboam put the weapons there. Literal brackets "were".

source.text: וְהַכֹּהֲנִים֙ וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הִֽתְיַצְּב֥וּ עָלָ֖יו מִכָּל־גְּבוּלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And the priests and the Levites who [were] in all Israel took their stand with him from all their territory.

en.L: And the priests and the Levites who [were] in all Israel took their stand with him from all their territory.
en.B: The priests and the Levites who lived throughout Israel took their stand with him, coming from all their territories.
en.R: The priests and Levites from all over Israel came to Rehoboam's side. They came from every area where they lived.

es.L: Y los sacerdotes y los levitas que [estaban] en todo Israel se pusieron de su lado desde todo su territorio.
es.B: Los sacerdotes y los levitas que vivían en todo Israel se pusieron de su lado, viniendo de todos sus territorios.
es.R: Los sacerdotes y los levitas de todo Israel se pusieron del lado de Roboam. Vinieron de todas las regiones donde vivían.

fr.L: Et les prêtres et les Lévites qui [étaient] dans tout Israël se rangèrent auprès de lui, de tout leur territoire.
fr.B: Les prêtres et les Lévites qui vivaient dans tout Israël se rangèrent de son côté, venant de tous leurs territoires.
fr.R: Les prêtres et les Lévites de tout Israël sont venus se mettre du côté de Roboam. Ils sont venus de toutes les régions où ils habitaient.

sw.L: Na makuhani na Walawi waliokuwa katika Israeli yote wakasimama pamoja naye kutoka katika mipaka yao yote.
sw.B: Makuhani na Walawi walioishi katika Israeli yote walisimama upande wake, wakija kutoka katika maeneo yao yote.
sw.R: Makuhani na Walawi kutoka kila sehemu ya Israeli walikuja upande wa Rehoboamu. Walikuja kutoka kila eneo walikoishi.

vi.L: Các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi [ở] trong cả Y-sơ-ra-ên đứng về phía vua, từ khắp địa phận của họ.
vi.B: Các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi sống khắp Y-sơ-ra-ên đều đứng về phía vua, từ mọi địa phận của họ mà đến.
vi.R: Các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi từ khắp Y-sơ-ra-ên đến đứng về phía Rô-bô-am. Họ đến từ mọi vùng họ sinh sống.

ko.L: 그리고 온 이스라엘에 있는 제사장들과 레위인들이 그들의 모든 영토에서 나와 그의 편에 섰다.
ko.B: 온 이스라엘에 흩어져 살던 제사장들과 레위인들이 그들이 살던 모든 지역에서 나와 르호보암 편에 섰다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 곳곳에 살던 제사장들과 레위인들이 르호보암 편으로 왔다. 그들은 자기들이 살던 모든 지역에서 왔다.

decisions.choice: took their stand with him: sided with him
decisions.reason: The verb means to take one's stand or present oneself. With this preposition it means they came over to Rehoboam and stood with him.

decisions.choice: the priests and Levites lived throughout Israel
decisions.reason: The Levites had no tribal land of their own but were given towns in the territory of every tribe (Numbers 35:1-8; Joshua 21). So many of them lived in the north.

decisions.choice: all Israel: here including the northern tribes
decisions.reason: Here "all Israel" means the whole land of the twelve tribes, north and south, from which the priests and Levites came.

decisions.choice: Rehoboam's side
decisions.reason: Readable names Rehoboam and explains the picture of taking one's stand with someone.

source.text: כִּֽי־עָזְב֣וּ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם אֶת־מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶם֙ וַאֲחֻזָּתָ֔ם וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ לִיהוּדָ֖ה וְלִֽירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּֽי־הִזְנִיחָ֤ם יָֽרָבְעָם֙ וּבָנָ֔יו מִכַּהֵ֖ן לַיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For left the Levites their pasturelands and their property, and they went to Judah and to Jerusalem, for had rejected them Jeroboam and his sons from serving as priests to Yahweh.

en.L: For the Levites left their pasturelands and their property and went to Judah and to Jerusalem, because Jeroboam and his sons had rejected them from serving as priests to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: The Levites left their pasturelands and their property and came to Judah and Jerusalem, because Jeroboam and his sons had cast them out of their service as priests of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: The Levites left their pasturelands and their property and moved to Judah and Jerusalem. They did this because Jeroboam and his sons would not let them serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as priests.

es.L: Porque los levitas dejaron sus campos de pasto y su propiedad y fueron a Judá y a Jerusalén, porque Jeroboam y sus hijos los habían echado de servir como sacerdotes {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Los levitas dejaron sus campos de pasto y sus propiedades y vinieron a Judá y a Jerusalén, porque Jeroboam y sus hijos los habían echado de su servicio como sacerdotes {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Los levitas dejaron sus campos de pasto y sus propiedades y se fueron a vivir a Judá y a Jerusalén. Lo hicieron porque Jeroboam y sus hijos no los dejaban servir {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} como sacerdotes.

fr.L: Car les Lévites abandonnèrent leurs pâturages et leur propriété, et ils allèrent en Juda et à Jérusalem, parce que Jéroboam et ses fils les avaient rejetés pour qu’ils n’exercent plus le sacerdoce pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Les Lévites abandonnèrent leurs pâturages et leurs biens et vinrent en Juda et à Jérusalem, parce que Jéroboam et ses fils les avaient écartés de leur service de prêtres {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Les Lévites ont quitté leurs pâturages et leurs biens, et ils sont allés s’installer en Juda et à Jérusalem. Ils l’ont fait parce que Jéroboam et ses fils ne les laissaient plus servir {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} comme prêtres.

sw.L: Kwa maana Walawi waliacha malisho yao na mali yao, wakaja Yuda na Yerusalemu, kwa sababu Yeroboamu na wanawe walikuwa wamewakataa wasimtumikie {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kama makuhani.
sw.B: Walawi waliacha malisho yao na mali yao, wakaja Yuda na Yerusalemu, kwa sababu Yeroboamu na wanawe walikuwa wamewafukuza wasiendelee na huduma yao ya ukuhani kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Walawi waliacha malisho yao na mali yao, wakahamia Yuda na Yerusalemu. Walifanya hivyo kwa sababu Yeroboamu na wanawe hawakuwaruhusu kumtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kama makuhani.

vi.L: Vì người Lê-vi bỏ các đồng cỏ và tài sản mình mà đến Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem, vì Giê-rô-bô-am và các con trai vua đã gạt bỏ họ, không cho làm thầy tế lễ phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Người Lê-vi bỏ các đồng cỏ và tài sản mình mà đến Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem, vì Giê-rô-bô-am và các con trai vua đã loại họ khỏi chức thầy tế lễ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Người Lê-vi bỏ các đồng cỏ và tài sản mình mà dọn đến Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem. Họ làm vậy vì Giê-rô-bô-am và các con trai vua không cho họ làm thầy tế lễ phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nữa.

ko.L: 레위인들이 자기 목초지와 소유를 버리고 유다와 예루살렘으로 왔다. 여로보암과 그의 아들들이 그들을 버려 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 제사장 직분을 행하지 못하게 했기 때문이다.
ko.B: 레위인들은 자기 목초지와 재산을 버리고 유다와 예루살렘으로 왔다. 여로보암과 그의 아들들이 그들을 쫓아내어 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 제사장으로 섬기지 못하게 했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 레위인들은 자기 목초지와 재산을 버리고 유다와 예루살렘으로 옮겨 왔다. 여로보암과 그의 아들들이 그들에게 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬기는 제사장 일을 하지 못하게 했기 때문이다.

decisions.choice: pasturelands and property: the Levites' towns and the land around them
decisions.reason: The law gave the Levites towns with open land around them for their cattle and flocks (Numbers 35:2-5). Leaving these meant giving up their homes and living.

decisions.choice: rejected them from serving as priests: shut them out of the priesthood
decisions.reason: The verb means to reject or cast off. Jeroboam made his own priests from people who were not Levites (1 Kings 12:31; 13:33), so the Levites lost their place.

decisions.choice: the Levites: here including the priests
decisions.reason: The priests were themselves of the tribe of Levi, so "the Levites" here covers both groups named in verse 13.

decisions.choice: Jeroboam and his sons: the policy of his house
decisions.reason: The words "and his sons" show that the exclusion continued under Jeroboam's family after him; the writer looks back on the whole period.

decisions.choice: no "for" at the start
decisions.reason: The opening word explains verse 13. Balanced and Readable leave it out, since the link is clear from the order of the sentences.

source.text: וַיַּֽעֲמֶד־לוֹ֙ כֹּֽהֲנִ֔ים לַבָּמ֖וֹת וְלַשְּׂעִירִ֑ים וְלָעֲגָלִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he appointed for himself priests for the high places and for the goat-demons and for the calves which he had made.

en.L: And he appointed for himself priests for the high places and for the goat-demons and for the calves that he had made.
en.B: He appointed his own priests for the high places, for the goat-demons and for the calves he had made.
en.R: Jeroboam chose his own priests to serve at the hilltop shrines and to serve the goat-demons and the calf idols he had made.

es.L: E hizo para sí sacerdotes para los lugares altos y para los demonios cabríos y para los becerros que había hecho.
es.B: Nombró sus propios sacerdotes para los lugares altos, para los demonios cabríos y para los becerros que había hecho.
es.R: Jeroboam escogió sus propios sacerdotes para servir en los santuarios sobre las colinas y para servir a los demonios con forma de cabra y a los ídolos de becerros que había hecho.

fr.L: Et il s’établit des prêtres pour les hauts lieux, et pour les démons-boucs, et pour les veaux qu’il avait faits.
fr.B: Il établit ses propres prêtres pour les hauts lieux, pour les démons-boucs et pour les veaux qu’il avait faits.
fr.R: Jéroboam a choisi ses propres prêtres pour servir dans les sanctuaires sur les collines, et pour servir les démons en forme de bouc et les statues de veaux qu’il avait faites.

sw.L: Naye akajiwekea makuhani kwa ajili ya mahali pa juu, na kwa ajili ya mashetani-mbuzi, na kwa ajili ya ndama aliowafanya.
sw.B: Akaweka makuhani wake mwenyewe kwa ajili ya mahali pa juu, kwa ajili ya mashetani-mbuzi na kwa ajili ya ndama aliowafanya.
sw.R: Yeroboamu alichagua makuhani wake mwenyewe kuhudumu katika patakatifu pa kilimani na kuwatumikia mashetani wenye umbo la mbuzi na sanamu za ndama alizozitengeneza.

vi.L: Vua lập cho mình các thầy tế lễ cho các nơi cao, cho các dê quỷ và cho các bò con mà vua đã làm.
vi.B: Vua lập các thầy tế lễ riêng cho các nơi cao, cho các dê quỷ và cho các bò con vua đã làm.
vi.R: Giê-rô-bô-am chọn các thầy tế lễ riêng để phục vụ tại các nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao, và để phục vụ các dê quỷ và các tượng bò con vua đã làm.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 산당들과 숫염소 귀신들과 그가 만든 송아지들을 위하여 자기를 위한 제사장들을 세웠다.
ko.B: 그는 산당들과 숫염소 귀신들과 자기가 만든 송아지들을 섬길 제사장들을 마음대로 세웠다.
ko.R: 여로보암은 자기 마음대로 제사장들을 뽑아, 산꼭대기 제단에서 섬기고 숫염소 귀신들과 자기가 만든 송아지 우상들을 섬기게 했다.

decisions.choice: the goat-demons: beings worshiped in the form of goats
decisions.reason: The word is the ordinary word for male goats. Here, as in Leviticus 17:7, it names beings that were worshiped as gods; Isaiah 13:21 and 34:14 picture such creatures in desolate places. Whether images of goats or the spirits they stood for are chiefly meant is not certain; either way they are false gods.

decisions.choice: priests, high places, calves: as in 1 Kings 12:28-33
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 12:28-33 tells how Jeroboam set up golden calves at Bethel and Dan, built shrines on the high places, and made priests who were not Levites. Chronicles adds the goat-demons to the list.

decisions.choice: for himself: priests of his own choosing
decisions.reason: The priests served Jeroboam's purposes and were his appointees, in contrast to the Levites the law appointed.

decisions.choice: that he had made: the calves, and the whole worship
decisions.reason: "That he had made" belongs to the calves; it echoes how 1 Kings 12:28-33 keeps saying what Jeroboam made.

decisions.choice: hilltop shrines; calf idols
decisions.reason: Readable says "hilltop shrines" for the high places, as throughout Samuel, Kings and Chronicles, and "calf idols" to show the calves were images.

decisions.choice: "los demonios cabríos" (L, B); "los demonios con forma de cabra" (R)
decisions.reason: The word for male goats names beings worshiped in the form of goats (meaning decision); Spanish says "demonios" with the goat in the adjective, and Readable spells it out.

decisions.choice: "lugares altos" (L, B); "santuarios sobre las colinas" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Kings terms note and the Spanish Kings drafts set for *bamot*.

decisions.choice: "les démons-boucs" (L, B); "les démons en forme de bouc" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is the plural of "goat" used for beings worshiped in that form (m1); French joins the two words, as the English "goat-demons" does, rather than "satyres", a Greek picture. Marked uncertain.

decisions.choice: mashetani-mbuzi (Literal, Balanced); mashetani wenye umbo la mbuzi (Readable)
decisions.reason: The word names demons pictured as goats (Leviticus 17:7); Swahili joins "mashetani" and "mbuzi", and Readable spells the picture out.

decisions.choice: "dê quỷ"
decisions.reason: Beings worshiped in the form of goats (m1); the word is the one for male goats, so Vietnamese joins "dê" with "quỷ" to show they were worshiped as spirits.

decisions.choice: "산당" (L, B), "산꼭대기 제단" (R); "숫염소 귀신"; "송아지" (L, B), "송아지 우상" (R)
decisions.reason: Beings worshiped in the form of goats (m1); "숫염소 귀신" says both the animal and the demon.

source.text: וְאַחֲרֵיהֶ֗ם מִכֹּל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַנֹּֽתְנִים֙ אֶת־לְבָבָ֔ם לְבַקֵּ֕שׁ אֶת־יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בָּ֚אוּ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לִזְבּ֕וֹחַ לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And after them, from all [the] tribes of Israel, those setting their heart to seek Yahweh, [the] God of Israel, came [to] Jerusalem to sacrifice to Yahweh, [the] God of their fathers.

en.L: And after them, from all the tribes of Israel, those who set their heart to seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the God of Israel came [to] Jerusalem to sacrifice to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the God of their fathers.
en.B: Following them, people from all the tribes of Israel who had set their hearts on seeking {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, came to Jerusalem to sacrifice to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of their ancestors.
en.R: After the priests and Levites came, people from every tribe of Israel who had made up their minds to seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, also came to Jerusalem. They came to offer sacrifices to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of their ancestors.

es.L: Y tras ellos, de todas las tribus de Israel, los que habían puesto su corazón en buscar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, vinieron [a] Jerusalén para ofrecer sacrificios {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios de sus padres.
es.B: Tras ellos, gente de todas las tribus de Israel que había puesto su corazón en buscar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, vino a Jerusalén para ofrecer sacrificios {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios de sus antepasados.
es.R: Después de los sacerdotes y los levitas, gente de todas las tribus de Israel que había decidido buscar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, también vino a Jerusalén. Vinieron a ofrecer sacrificios {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios de sus antepasados.

fr.L: Et après eux, de toutes les tribus d’Israël, ceux qui appliquaient leur cœur à rechercher {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, vinrent [à] Jérusalem pour sacrifier {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, le Dieu de leurs pères.
fr.B: À leur suite, des gens de toutes les tribus d’Israël, qui avaient à cœur de rechercher {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, vinrent à Jérusalem pour offrir des sacrifices {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, le Dieu de leurs ancêtres.
fr.R: Après l’arrivée des prêtres et des Lévites, des gens de toutes les tribus d’Israël qui avaient décidé de chercher {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, sont venus eux aussi à Jérusalem. Ils sont venus offrir des sacrifices {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, le Dieu de leurs ancêtres.

sw.L: Na baada yao, kutoka katika makabila yote ya Israeli, wale walioweka mioyo yao kumtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wa Israeli wakaja Yerusalemu kumtolea dhabihu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wa baba zao.
sw.B: Wakiwafuata, watu kutoka makabila yote ya Israeli walioweka mioyo yao kumtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, walikuja Yerusalemu kumtolea dhabihu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa babu zao.
sw.R: Baada ya makuhani na Walawi kuja, watu kutoka kila kabila la Israeli walioamua kumtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, nao walikuja Yerusalemu. Walikuja kumtolea dhabihu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa babu zao.

vi.L: Sau họ, từ mọi chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên, những người quyết lòng tìm cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, đến Giê-ru-sa-lem để dâng sinh tế cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ phụ họ.
vi.B: Theo sau họ, những người từ mọi chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên đã quyết lòng tìm cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, cũng đến Giê-ru-sa-lem để dâng sinh tế cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên họ.
vi.R: Sau khi các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi đến, những người từ mọi chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên đã quyết lòng tìm cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, cũng đến Giê-ru-sa-lem. Họ đến để dâng sinh tế cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên họ.

ko.L: 그리고 그들의 뒤를 이어, 이스라엘의 모든 지파에서 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾기로 마음을 정한 사람들이 그들 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 제사를 드리려고 예루살렘으로 왔다.
ko.B: 제사장들과 레위인들의 뒤를 이어, 이스라엘 모든 지파에서 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾기로 마음을 정한 사람들이 그들 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 제사를 드리려고 예루살렘으로 왔다.
ko.R: 제사장들과 레위인들이 온 뒤에, 이스라엘 모든 지파에서 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾기로 마음먹은 사람들도 예루살렘으로 왔다. 그들은 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 제물을 바치려고 왔다.

decisions.choice: after them: following the priests and Levites
decisions.reason: "After them" may mean later in time or following their lead; either way the priests and Levites came first and others from the north followed.

decisions.choice: set their heart to seek the LORD: were determined to worship him
decisions.reason: To "seek the LORD" is to turn to him in worship and obedience, a phrase Chronicles uses often (1 Chronicles 22:19; 2 Chronicles 7:14). "Setting the heart" means making a firm decision.

decisions.choice: came to Jerusalem to sacrifice: the place the LORD chose
decisions.reason: The law told Israel to bring sacrifices to the place the LORD would choose (Deuteronomy 12:5-14), which was now the temple in Jerusalem. The text does not say whether these people moved south or came as pilgrims.

decisions.choice: ancestors
decisions.reason: "Fathers" means forefathers; Balanced and Readable say "ancestors".

decisions.choice: After the priests and Levites came
decisions.reason: Readable names who "them" are and splits the sentence.

decisions.choice: "padres" (L); "antepasados" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1) and the Kings terms note: "padres" at Literal, "antepasados" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: "rechercher le SEIGNEUR" (L, B); "chercher le SEIGNEUR" (R)
decisions.reason: Seeking Yahweh, a theme Chronicles returns to again and again, is kept as "rechercher" at Literal and Balanced and "chercher" at Readable, so that the word stays recognisable each time; "consulter" is kept for asking an oracle.

source.text: וַֽיְחַזְּקוּ֙ אֶת־מַלְכ֣וּת יְהוּדָ֔ה וַֽיְאַמְּצ֛וּ אֶת־רְחַבְעָ֥ם בֶּן־שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְשָׁנִ֣ים שָׁל֑וֹשׁ כִּ֣י הָֽלְכ֗וּ בְּדֶ֧רֶךְ דָּוִ֛יד וּשְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְשָׁנִ֥ים שָׁלֽוֹשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And they strengthened [the] kingdom of Judah and made strong Rehoboam son of Solomon for three years, for they walked in [the] way of David and Solomon for three years.

en.L: And they strengthened the kingdom of Judah and made Rehoboam son of Solomon strong for three years, for they walked in the way of David and Solomon for three years.
en.B: They gave strength to the kingdom of Judah and stood by Rehoboam son of Solomon for three years, since for three years they walked in the way of David and Solomon.
en.R: These people made the kingdom of Judah strong, and for three years they stood behind Rehoboam son of Solomon. For three years they lived the way David and Solomon had lived.

es.L: Y fortalecieron el reino de Judá y apoyaron a Roboam hijo de Salomón durante tres años, porque anduvieron en el camino de David y de Salomón durante tres años.
es.B: Dieron fuerza al reino de Judá y respaldaron a Roboam hijo de Salomón durante tres años, porque durante tres años anduvieron en el camino de David y de Salomón.
es.R: Esta gente hizo fuerte al reino de Judá, y durante tres años apoyó a Roboam hijo de Salomón. Durante tres años vivieron como habían vivido David y Salomón.

fr.L: Et ils fortifièrent le royaume de Juda et affermirent Roboam fils de Salomon pendant trois ans, car ils marchèrent dans la voie de David et de Salomon pendant trois ans.
fr.B: Ils donnèrent de la force au royaume de Juda et soutinrent Roboam, fils de Salomon, pendant trois ans, car pendant trois ans ils marchèrent dans la voie de David et de Salomon.
fr.R: Ces gens ont rendu le royaume de Juda solide, et pendant trois ans ils ont soutenu Roboam, fils de Salomon. Pendant trois ans, ils ont vécu comme David et Salomon avaient vécu.

sw.L: Wakauimarisha ufalme wa Yuda, wakamtia nguvu Rehoboamu mwana wa Sulemani miaka mitatu, kwa maana walikwenda katika njia ya Daudi na Sulemani miaka mitatu.
sw.B: Wakaupa nguvu ufalme wa Yuda na kumuunga mkono Rehoboamu mwana wa Sulemani kwa miaka mitatu, kwa kuwa kwa miaka mitatu walienenda katika njia ya Daudi na Sulemani.
sw.R: Watu hao waliufanya ufalme wa Yuda kuwa imara, na kwa miaka mitatu walimuunga mkono Rehoboamu mwana wa Sulemani. Kwa miaka mitatu waliishi kama Daudi na Sulemani walivyoishi.

vi.L: Họ làm cho vương quốc Giu-đa vững mạnh và làm cho Rô-bô-am con trai Sa-lô-môn vững mạnh trong ba năm, vì họ bước đi trong đường lối của Đa-vít và Sa-lô-môn ba năm.
vi.B: Họ làm cho vương quốc Giu-đa vững mạnh và ủng hộ Rô-bô-am con trai Sa-lô-môn trong ba năm, vì suốt ba năm ấy họ bước đi theo đường lối của Đa-vít và Sa-lô-môn.
vi.R: Những người này làm cho vương quốc Giu-đa vững mạnh, và trong ba năm họ ủng hộ Rô-bô-am con trai Sa-lô-môn. Suốt ba năm ấy họ sống theo cách Đa-vít và Sa-lô-môn đã sống.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 유다 나라를 강하게 했고, 솔로몬의 아들 르호보암을 3년 동안 강하게 했다. 그들이 3년 동안 다윗과 솔로몬의 길로 걸었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그들은 유다 나라에 힘이 되었고, 3년 동안 솔로몬의 아들 르호보암을 지지했다. 그들이 3년 동안 다윗과 솔로몬의 길을 따라 살았기 때문이다.
ko.R: 이 사람들은 유다 나라를 강하게 했다. 그들은 3년 동안 솔로몬의 아들 르호보암을 뒤에서 받쳐 주었다. 3년 동안 그들은 다윗과 솔로몬이 살았던 것처럼 살았다.

decisions.choice: they: the priests, Levites and people who came
decisions.reason: The subject carries on from verses 13-16: those who came to Jerusalem gave strength to Rehoboam's kingdom.

decisions.choice: walked in the way of David and Solomon: followed their faithfulness to the LORD
decisions.reason: To "walk in the way" of someone is to live as they did. Chronicles holds up David and Solomon as kings who were faithful to the LORD and his temple.

decisions.choice: three years: a time that came to an end
decisions.reason: The repeated "three years" prepares for 12:1-2: once Rehoboam was strong he abandoned the law of the LORD, and in his fifth year Shishak of Egypt attacked.

decisions.choice: stood by; stood behind
decisions.reason: The second verb means to make firm or support; Balanced says "stood by" and Readable "stood behind".

source.text: וַיִּֽקַּֽח־ל֤וֹ רְחַבְעָם֙ אִשָּׁ֔ה אֶת־מָ֣חֲלַ֔ת בַּת־יְרִימ֖וֹת בֶּן־דָּוִ֑יד אֲבִיהַ֕יִל בַּת־אֱלִיאָ֖ב בֶּן־יִשָֽׁי׃

records.literal_gloss: And took for himself Rehoboam [a] wife, Mahalath daughter of Jerimoth son of David, Abihail daughter of Eliab son of Jesse.

en.L: And Rehoboam took for himself [as] wife Mahalath daughter of Jerimoth son of David, Abihail daughter of Eliab son of Jesse.
en.B: Rehoboam married Mahalath, whose father was Jerimoth son of David and whose mother was Abihail daughter of Eliab son of Jesse.
en.R: Rehoboam married Mahalath. Her father was Jerimoth, a son of David, and her mother was Abihail, a daughter of Eliab, the son of Jesse.

es.L: Y tomó Roboam para sí [por] mujer a Mahalat hija de Jerimot hijo de David, [y de] Abihail hija de Eliab hijo de Isaí.
es.B: Roboam se casó con Mahalat, cuyo padre era Jerimot hijo de David y cuya madre era Abihail hija de Eliab hijo de Isaí.
es.R: Roboam se casó con Mahalat. Su padre era Jerimot, un hijo de David, y su madre era Abihail, una hija de Eliab, el hijo de Isaí.

fr.L: Et Roboam prit pour lui [comme] femme Mahalath fille de Yerimoth fils de David, [et] Abihaïl fille d’Éliab fils de Jessé.
fr.B: Roboam épousa Mahalath, dont le père était Yerimoth, fils de David, et la mère Abihaïl, fille d’Éliab, fils de Jessé.
fr.R: Roboam a épousé Mahalath. Son père était Yerimoth, un fils de David, et sa mère était Abihaïl, une fille d’Éliab, le fils de Jessé.

sw.L: Rehoboamu akajitwalia mke, Mahalathi binti Yerimothi mwana wa Daudi, [na] Abihaili binti Eliabu mwana wa Yese.
sw.B: Rehoboamu alimwoa Mahalathi, ambaye baba yake alikuwa Yerimothi mwana wa Daudi, na mama yake alikuwa Abihaili binti Eliabu mwana wa Yese.
sw.R: Rehoboamu alimwoa Mahalathi. Baba yake alikuwa Yerimothi, mmoja wa wana wa Daudi, na mama yake alikuwa Abihaili, binti Eliabu, mwana wa Yese.

vi.L: Rô-bô-am lấy cho mình [làm] vợ Ma-ha-lát, con gái Giê-ri-mốt con trai Đa-vít, [và] A-bi-hai con gái Ê-li-áp con trai Gie-sê.
vi.B: Rô-bô-am cưới Ma-ha-lát, cha nàng là Giê-ri-mốt con trai Đa-vít, còn mẹ nàng là A-bi-hai con gái Ê-li-áp con trai Gie-sê.
vi.R: Rô-bô-am cưới Ma-ha-lát. Cha nàng là Giê-ri-mốt, một con trai của Đa-vít, còn mẹ nàng là A-bi-hai, con gái của Ê-li-áp, con trai Gie-sê.

ko.L: 그리고 르호보암이 다윗의 아들 여리못의 딸 마할랏과, 이새의 아들 엘리압의 딸 아비하일을 아내로 맞았다.
ko.B: 르호보암은 마할랏과 결혼했다. 마할랏의 아버지는 다윗의 아들 여리못이었고, 어머니는 이새의 아들 엘리압의 딸 아비하일이었다.
ko.R: 르호보암은 마할랏과 결혼했다. 마할랏의 아버지는 다윗의 아들 여리못이었고, 어머니는 이새의 아들 엘리압의 딸 아비하일이었다.

decisions.choice: Abihail: Mahalath's mother
alternatives: Abihail as a second wife of Rehoboam
decisions.reason: The verse says Rehoboam took "a wife", one woman, and verse 19 says "she bore him sons". So Abihail is most likely named as Mahalath's mother, giving her descent on both sides. The verse could also be read as naming Abihail as a second wife.

decisions.choice: daughter of Jerimoth: the form marked to be read aloud
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) have "son", but the form the scribes marked to be read aloud (qere) is "daughter", which fits Mahalath.

decisions.choice: Jerimoth son of David; Eliab son of Jesse
decisions.reason: Jerimoth is not named among David's sons in 1 Chronicles 3:1-9 and 14:4-7; he may have been the son of a concubine (3:9). Eliab was David's oldest brother (1 Samuel 16:6; 17:13). Rehoboam married within David's own family.

decisions.choice: married
decisions.reason: "Took for himself a wife" means "married"; Literal keeps the Hebrew wording.

decisions.choice: whose mother was Abihail; her mother was Abihail
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the likely relationship clear (m1); the alternative is footnoted.

decisions.choice: "Mahalat", "Jerimot", "Abihail"
decisions.reason: The names take their usual Spanish forms; Abihail is taken as Mahalath's mother (meaning decision), so Literal supplies "[y de]".

decisions.choice: "어머니는 ... 아비하일이었다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Abihail is Mahalath's mother (m1), as the English Balanced and Readable say.

source.text: וַתֵּ֥לֶד ל֖וֹ בָּנִ֑ים אֶת־יְע֥וּשׁ וְאֶת־שְׁמַרְיָ֖ה וְאֶת־זָֽהַם׃

records.literal_gloss: And she bore to him sons: Jeush and Shemariah and Zaham.

en.L: And she bore him sons: Jeush and Shemariah and Zaham.
en.B: She bore him sons: Jeush, Shemariah and Zaham.
en.R: She and Rehoboam had three sons: Jeush, Shemariah and Zaham.

es.L: Y ella le dio hijos: Jeús y Semarías y Zaham.
es.B: Ella le dio hijos: Jeús, Semarías y Zaham.
es.R: Ella y Roboam tuvieron tres hijos: Jeús, Semarías y Zaham.

fr.L: Et elle lui enfanta des fils : Yéoush, et Shemarya, et Zaham.
fr.B: Elle lui donna des fils : Yéoush, Shemarya et Zaham.
fr.R: Mahalath et Roboam ont eu trois fils : Yéoush, Shemarya et Zaham.

sw.L: Akamzalia wana: Yeushi na Shemaria na Zahamu.
sw.B: Akamzalia wana: Yeushi, Shemaria na Zahamu.
sw.R: Yeye na Rehoboamu walipata wana watatu: Yeushi, Shemaria na Zahamu.

vi.L: Nàng sinh cho vua các con trai: Giê-úc, Sê-ma-ri-a và Xa-ham.
vi.B: Nàng sinh cho vua các con trai: Giê-úc, Sê-ma-ri-a và Xa-ham.
vi.R: Nàng và Rô-bô-am có ba con trai: Giê-úc, Sê-ma-ri-a và Xa-ham.

ko.L: 그리고 그 여자가 그에게 아들들, 곧 여우스와 스마랴와 사함을 낳았다.
ko.B: 마할랏은 르호보암에게 아들들, 곧 여우스와 스마랴와 사함을 낳아 주었다.
ko.R: 마할랏과 르호보암 사이에서 아들 셋, 여우스와 스마랴와 사함이 태어났다.

decisions.choice: she: Mahalath
decisions.reason: The verb is singular and feminine; it refers to Mahalath, the wife named in verse 18.

decisions.choice: three
decisions.reason: Readable gives the number of sons, which the list makes plain.

source.text: וְאַחֲרֶ֣יהָ לָקַ֔ח אֶֽת־מַעֲכָ֖ה בַּת־אַבְשָׁל֑וֹם וַתֵּ֣לֶד ל֗וֹ אֶת־אֲבִיָּה֙ וְאֶת־עַתַּ֔י וְאֶת־זִיזָ֖א וְאֶת־שְׁלֹמִֽית׃

records.literal_gloss: And after her he took Maacah daughter of Absalom, and she bore to him Abijah and Attai and Ziza and Shelomith.

en.L: And after her he took Maacah daughter of Absalom, and she bore him Abijah and Attai and Ziza and Shelomith.
en.B: After her he married Maacah daughter of Absalom, and she bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza and Shelomith.
en.R: Later he married Maacah, the daughter of Absalom. She and Rehoboam had four children: Abijah, Attai, Ziza and Shelomith.

es.L: Y después de ella tomó a Maaca hija de Absalón, y ella le dio a Abías y a Atai y a Ziza y a Selomit.
es.B: Después de ella se casó con Maaca hija de Absalón, y ella le dio a Abías, Atai, Ziza y Selomit.
es.R: Más tarde se casó con Maaca, la hija de Absalón. Ella y Roboam tuvieron cuatro hijos: Abías, Atai, Ziza y Selomit.

fr.L: Et après elle, il prit Maaka fille d’Absalom, et elle lui enfanta Abiya, et Attaï, et Ziza, et Shelomith.
fr.B: Après elle, il épousa Maaka, fille d’Absalom, qui lui donna Abiya, Attaï, Ziza et Shelomith.
fr.R: Plus tard, il a épousé Maaka, la fille d’Absalom. Maaka et Roboam ont eu quatre enfants : Abiya, Attaï, Ziza et Shelomith.

sw.L: Baada yake akamtwaa Maaka binti Absalomu, naye akamzalia Abiya na Atai na Ziza na Shelomithi.
sw.B: Baada yake alimwoa Maaka binti Absalomu, naye akamzalia Abiya, Atai, Ziza na Shelomithi.
sw.R: Baadaye alimwoa Maaka, binti Absalomu. Yeye na Rehoboamu walipata watoto wanne: Abiya, Atai, Ziza na Shelomithi.

vi.L: Sau nàng, vua lấy Ma-a-ca con gái Áp-sa-lôm, và nàng sinh cho vua A-bi-gia, Ạt-tai, Xi-xa và Sê-lô-mít.
vi.B: Sau nàng, vua cưới Ma-a-ca con gái Áp-sa-lôm, và nàng sinh cho vua A-bi-gia, Ạt-tai, Xi-xa và Sê-lô-mít.
vi.R: Sau đó vua cưới Ma-a-ca, con gái Áp-sa-lôm. Nàng và Rô-bô-am có bốn người con: A-bi-gia, Ạt-tai, Xi-xa và Sê-lô-mít.

ko.L: 그리고 그 뒤에 그가 압살롬의 딸 마아가를 맞았고, 그 여자가 그에게 아비야와 앗대와 시사와 슬로밋을 낳았다.
ko.B: 그 뒤에 그는 압살롬의 딸 마아가와 결혼했고, 마아가는 그에게 아비야와 앗대와 시사와 슬로밋을 낳아 주었다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 그는 압살롬의 딸 마아가와 결혼했다. 마아가와 르호보암 사이에서 네 자녀, 아비야와 앗대와 시사와 슬로밋이 태어났다.

decisions.choice: Maacah daughter of Absalom: probably Absalom son of David; "daughter" may mean granddaughter
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 15:2 calls her "Maacah daughter of Abishalom", a fuller form of the name Absalom. Absalom's only daughter we know of was Tamar (2 Samuel 14:27), so Maacah may have been his granddaughter, as "daughter" can mean a female descendant. 2 Chronicles 13:2 names Abijah's mother "Micaiah daughter of Uriel of Gibeah". The text says "daughter", and every level keeps it.

decisions.choice: Abijah: called Abijam in Kings
decisions.reason: This is the son who became king after Rehoboam (12:16). 1 Kings 14:31 and 15:1-8 call him Abijam.

decisions.choice: Shelomith: son or daughter
decisions.reason: The name is used of women (1 Chronicles 3:19) and of men (1 Chronicles 23:9). Here it is not clear which is meant.

decisions.choice: four children
decisions.reason: Readable says "children", not "sons", because Shelomith may be a daughter (m3).

decisions.choice: "Maaca hija de Absalón"; "Abías"
decisions.reason: Chronicles writes Absalom where 1 Kings 15:2 has Abishalom, and Abijah where Kings has Abijam (meaning decisions); Spanish keeps the form each verse uses, as the Kings terms note sets.

decisions.choice: "Maaka fille d'Absalom"; "Abiya"
decisions.reason: Chronicles spells the name Absalom, as 2 Samuel does, where 1 Kings 15:2 has Abishalom; French keeps each book's form. Abiya is the terms note's form; Kings calls him Abiyam.

decisions.choice: "Áp-sa-lôm"; "A-bi-gia"
decisions.reason: Chronicles spells the father as David's son Absalom (m1), so the Samuel form is used; Kings' spelling Abishalom keeps "A-bi-sa-lôm". The son is Abijah here, Abijam in Kings (m2), and each book keeps its own form, as the terms note.

decisions.choice: "아비야" (Chronicles), kept apart from "아비얌" (Kings)
decisions.reason: Each book's form of the king's name, as the terms note.

source.text: וַיֶּאֱהַ֨ב רְחַבְעָ֜ם אֶת־מַעֲכָ֣ה בַת־אַבְשָׁל֗וֹם מִכָּל־נָשָׁיו֙ וּפִ֣ילַגְשָׁ֔יו כִּ֠י נָשִׁ֤ים שְׁמוֹנֶֽה־עֶשְׂרֵה֙ נָשָׂ֔א וּפִֽילַגְשִׁ֖ים שִׁשִּׁ֑ים וַיּ֗וֹלֶד עֶשְׂרִ֧ים וּשְׁמוֹנָ֛ה בָּנִ֖ים וְשִׁשִּׁ֥ים בָּנֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And loved Rehoboam Maacah daughter of Absalom more than all his wives and his concubines, for wives eighteen he had taken and concubines sixty, and he fathered twenty and eight sons and sixty daughters.

en.L: And Rehoboam loved Maacah daughter of Absalom more than all his wives and his concubines, for he had taken eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and he fathered twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.
en.B: Rehoboam loved Maacah daughter of Absalom more than all his other wives and concubines. He had taken eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and he fathered twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.
en.R: Rehoboam loved Maacah, the daughter of Absalom, more than any of his other wives and concubines (secondary wives). In all, he married eighteen wives and had sixty concubines. He had twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.

es.L: Y amó Roboam a Maaca hija de Absalón más que a todas sus mujeres y sus concubinas, porque había tomado dieciocho mujeres y sesenta concubinas, y engendró veintiocho hijos y sesenta hijas.
es.B: Roboam amaba a Maaca hija de Absalón más que a todas sus otras esposas y concubinas. Había tomado dieciocho esposas y sesenta concubinas, y tuvo veintiocho hijos y sesenta hijas.
es.R: Roboam amaba a Maaca, la hija de Absalón, más que a todas sus otras esposas y concubinas (esposas de segundo rango). En total se casó con dieciocho esposas y tuvo sesenta concubinas. Tuvo veintiocho hijos y sesenta hijas.

fr.L: Et Roboam aima Maaka fille d’Absalom plus que toutes ses femmes et ses concubines, car il avait pris dix-huit femmes et soixante concubines, et il engendra vingt-huit fils et soixante filles.
fr.B: Roboam aima Maaka, fille d’Absalom, plus que toutes ses autres femmes et ses concubines. Il avait pris dix-huit femmes et soixante concubines, et il eut vingt-huit fils et soixante filles.
fr.R: Roboam aimait Maaka, la fille d’Absalom, plus que toutes ses autres femmes et ses concubines (des épouses de second rang). En tout, il a épousé dix-huit femmes et il a eu soixante concubines. Il a eu vingt-huit fils et soixante filles.

sw.L: Rehoboamu akampenda Maaka binti Absalomu kuliko wake zake wote na masuria wake, kwa maana alikuwa ametwaa wake kumi na wanane na masuria sitini, akazaa wana ishirini na wanane na binti sitini.
sw.B: Rehoboamu alimpenda Maaka binti Absalomu kuliko wake zake wengine wote na masuria wake. Alikuwa ameoa wake kumi na wanane na masuria sitini, naye akazaa wana ishirini na wanane na binti sitini.
sw.R: Rehoboamu alimpenda Maaka, binti Absalomu, kuliko wake zake wengine wote na masuria wake (wake wadogo). Kwa jumla alioa wake kumi na wanane na alikuwa na masuria sitini. Alikuwa na wana ishirini na wanane na binti sitini.

vi.L: Rô-bô-am yêu Ma-a-ca con gái Áp-sa-lôm hơn tất cả các vợ và cung phi của vua, vì vua đã lấy mười tám vợ và sáu mươi cung phi, và sinh hai mươi tám con trai và sáu mươi con gái.
vi.B: Rô-bô-am yêu Ma-a-ca con gái Áp-sa-lôm hơn tất cả các vợ và cung phi khác. Vua đã lấy mười tám vợ và sáu mươi cung phi, và có hai mươi tám con trai và sáu mươi con gái.
vi.R: Rô-bô-am yêu Ma-a-ca, con gái Áp-sa-lôm, hơn tất cả các vợ và cung phi khác của mình (cung phi là vợ lẽ của vua). Vua cưới tất cả mười tám vợ và có sáu mươi cung phi. Vua có hai mươi tám con trai và sáu mươi con gái.

ko.L: 그리고 르호보암이 압살롬의 딸 마아가를 그의 모든 아내와 후궁보다 사랑했다. 그는 아내 열여덟 명과 후궁 예순 명을 맞았고, 아들 스물여덟 명과 딸 예순 명을 낳았기 때문이다.
ko.B: 르호보암은 압살롬의 딸 마아가를 다른 모든 아내와 후궁보다 더 사랑했다. 그는 아내 열여덟 명과 후궁 예순 명을 두었고, 아들 스물여덟 명과 딸 예순 명을 낳았다.
ko.R: 르호보암은 압살롬의 딸 마아가를 다른 어떤 아내나 후궁(지위가 낮은 아내)보다 더 사랑했다. 그는 모두 아내 열여덟 명과 후궁 예순 명을 두었다. 그리고 아들 스물여덟 명과 딸 예순 명을 낳았다.

decisions.choice: concubines: wives of lower rank
decisions.reason: A concubine was a lawful wife of lower standing, without the full rights of a principal wife; her children could still be counted among the king's sons (1 Chronicles 3:9).

decisions.choice: eighteen wives and sixty concubines: a royal household
decisions.reason: Kings of the time took many wives, often to make alliances. The law had warned the king not to take many wives (Deuteronomy 17:17), and Solomon's wives had led him astray (1 Kings 11:3-4). This verse records the numbers without comment.

decisions.choice: for: the size of the household makes his love for Maacah stand out
decisions.reason: The clause gives the background: among so many wives and concubines, Maacah was his favorite, which leads to verse 22.

decisions.choice: concubines (secondary wives)
decisions.reason: Readable explains "concubine" at its first use in the chapter, as Judges does.

decisions.choice: other
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "other", since Maacah was herself one of his wives.

decisions.choice: "concubinas (esposas de segundo rango)"
decisions.reason: As the English Readable explains the word (r-en-1), Spanish adds a short explanation of "concubinas", the word of the Spanish Samuel.

decisions.choice: masuria (Readable adds "wake wadogo")
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note sets for Swahili: "suria" for a concubine, explained at Readable.

decisions.choice: "cung phi", explained at R as "vợ lẽ của vua"
decisions.reason: The word for a king's wives of lower rank used in 1 Kings 11:3 (m1).

decisions.choice: "후궁" for concubines; R adds "(지위가 낮은 아내)"
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note; Readable explains the word once, as the English Readable does.

source.text: וַיַּֽעֲמֵ֨ד לָרֹ֧אשׁ רְחַבְעָ֛ם אֶת־אֲבִיָּ֥ה בֶֽן־מַעֲכָ֖ה לְנָגִ֣יד בְּאֶחָ֑יו כִּ֖י לְהַמְלִיכֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And appointed as head Rehoboam Abijah son of Maacah as ruler among his brothers, for to make him king.

en.L: And Rehoboam appointed Abijah son of Maacah as head, as ruler among his brothers, for [he meant] to make him king.
en.B: Rehoboam appointed Abijah son of Maacah as chief, the ruler among his brothers, because he intended to make him king.
en.R: Rehoboam put Abijah, Maacah's son, at the head of all his brothers as their leader, because he planned to make him the next king.

es.L: Y puso Roboam a Abías hijo de Maaca como cabeza, como gobernante entre sus hermanos, porque [quería] hacerlo rey.
es.B: Roboam nombró a Abías hijo de Maaca como jefe, el gobernante entre sus hermanos, porque tenía la intención de hacerlo rey.
es.R: Roboam puso a Abías, el hijo de Maaca, al frente de todos sus hermanos como su líder, porque pensaba hacerlo el próximo rey.

fr.L: Et Roboam établit Abiya fils de Maaka comme tête, comme chef parmi ses frères, car [il voulait] le faire roi.
fr.B: Roboam établit Abiya, fils de Maaka, comme le premier, le chef de ses frères, car il avait l’intention de le faire roi.
fr.R: Roboam a mis Abiya, le fils de Maaka, à la tête de tous ses frères, comme leur chef, parce qu’il avait prévu d’en faire le prochain roi.

sw.L: Rehoboamu akamweka Abiya mwana wa Maaka kuwa mkuu, kiongozi kati ya ndugu zake, kwa maana [alikusudia] kumfanya mfalme.
sw.B: Rehoboamu alimweka Abiya mwana wa Maaka kuwa mkuu, kiongozi kati ya ndugu zake, kwa sababu alikusudia kumfanya mfalme.
sw.R: Rehoboamu alimweka Abiya, mwana wa Maaka, juu ya ndugu zake wote kuwa kiongozi wao, kwa sababu alipanga kumfanya mfalme baada yake.

vi.L: Rô-bô-am lập A-bi-gia con trai Ma-a-ca làm đầu, làm người lãnh đạo giữa các anh em mình, vì [vua muốn] lập người làm vua.
vi.B: Rô-bô-am lập A-bi-gia con trai Ma-a-ca làm trưởng, làm người lãnh đạo các anh em mình, vì vua định lập người làm vua.
vi.R: Rô-bô-am đặt A-bi-gia, con trai Ma-a-ca, đứng đầu tất cả các anh em mình để lãnh đạo họ, vì vua định lập người làm vua kế vị.

ko.L: 그리고 르호보암이 마아가의 아들 아비야를 우두머리로 세워 그의 형제들 가운데 지도자로 삼았다. 그를 왕으로 삼으려는 것이었다.
ko.B: 르호보암은 마아가의 아들 아비야를 우두머리로 세워 형제들 가운데 지도자로 삼았다. 그를 왕으로 세우려고 했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 르호보암은 마아가의 아들 아비야를 모든 형제의 우두머리로 세웠다. 그를 다음 왕으로 세울 생각이었기 때문이다.

decisions.choice: Abijah chosen as heir though not the firstborn
decisions.reason: Mahalath's son Jeush was older (verses 19-20), but Rehoboam chose the son of his favorite wife, as David had chosen Solomon over older sons (1 Kings 1:17, 30).

decisions.choice: head ... ruler: the chief of the king's sons
decisions.reason: "Head" and "ruler" together give Abijah authority over his brothers as the appointed heir. "Ruler" is the title used for one chosen to lead God's people (1 Samuel 9:16; 1 Chronicles 29:22).

decisions.choice: for to make him king: his intention
decisions.reason: The short Hebrew phrase states Rehoboam's purpose: he meant Abijah to succeed him.

decisions.choice: leader; the next king
decisions.reason: Readable says "leader" for this title, as throughout these books, and "the next king" to show the purpose was the succession.

decisions.choice: "gobernante" (L, B); "líder" (R)
decisions.reason: *Nagid* follows the Samuel terms note for Spanish.

source.text: וַיָּבֶן֩ וַיִּפְרֹ֨ץ מִכָּל־בָּנָ֜יו לְֽכָל־אַרְצ֧וֹת יְהוּדָ֣ה וּבִנְיָמִ֗ן לְכֹל֙ עָרֵ֣י הַמְּצֻר֔וֹת וַיִּתֵּ֥ן לָהֶ֛ם הַמָּז֖וֹן לָרֹ֑ב וַיִּשְׁאַ֖ל הֲמ֥וֹן נָשִֽׁים׃

records.literal_gloss: And he acted wisely, and he dispersed from all his sons to all [the] lands of Judah and Benjamin, to all [the] cities of the fortifications, and he gave to them the provision in abundance, and he asked [for a] multitude of wives.

en.L: And he acted wisely and dispersed some of all his sons through all the lands of Judah and Benjamin, to all the fortified cities; and he gave them provisions in abundance, and he sought a multitude of wives.
en.B: He acted wisely: he dispersed some of his sons throughout all the districts of Judah and Benjamin, to all the fortified cities. He gave them plenty of provisions and sought many wives for them.
en.R: Rehoboam acted wisely. He sent some of his sons out to all the areas of Judah and Benjamin, to every fortified city. He gave them plenty of supplies, and he asked for many wives for them.

es.L: Y obró sabiamente, y repartió a algunos de todos sus hijos por todas las tierras de Judá y de Benjamín, por todas las ciudades fortificadas; y les dio provisiones en abundancia, y pidió multitud de mujeres.
es.B: Actuó con sabiduría: repartió a algunos de sus hijos por todos los distritos de Judá y de Benjamín, por todas las ciudades fortificadas. Les dio provisiones en abundancia y buscó muchas esposas para ellos.
es.R: Roboam actuó con sabiduría. Envió a algunos de sus hijos a todas las regiones de Judá y de Benjamín, a cada ciudad fortificada. Les dio muchas provisiones, y pidió muchas esposas para ellos.

fr.L: Et il agit avec sagesse, et il dispersa [une partie] de tous ses fils dans toutes les régions de Juda et de Benjamin, dans toutes les villes fortes ; et il leur donna des vivres en abondance, et il demanda une multitude de femmes.
fr.B: Il agit avec habileté : il répartit certains de ses fils dans tous les districts de Juda et de Benjamin, dans toutes les villes fortes. Il leur donna des vivres en abondance et leur chercha de nombreuses épouses.
fr.R: Roboam a agi avec sagesse. Il a envoyé certains de ses fils dans toutes les régions de Juda et de Benjamin, dans chaque ville fortifiée. Il leur a donné beaucoup de provisions, et il a demandé de nombreuses femmes pour eux.

sw.L: Akatenda kwa busara, akawatawanya baadhi ya wanawe wote katika nchi zote za Yuda na Benyamini, katika miji yote yenye ngome; akawapa chakula kwa wingi, akatafuta wake wengi.
sw.B: Alitenda kwa busara: aliwatawanya baadhi ya wanawe katika maeneo yote ya Yuda na Benyamini, katika miji yote yenye ngome. Akawapa chakula kingi na kuwatafutia wake wengi.
sw.R: Rehoboamu alitenda kwa busara. Aliwatuma baadhi ya wanawe katika maeneo yote ya Yuda na Benyamini, katika kila mji wenye ngome. Akawapa mahitaji mengi, akawatafutia wake wengi.

vi.L: Vua hành động khôn ngoan, phân tán một số trong tất cả các con trai mình đi khắp các miền Giu-đa và Bên-gia-min, đến tất cả các thành kiên cố; vua cấp cho họ lương thực dồi dào, và tìm nhiều vợ.
vi.B: Vua hành động khôn ngoan: vua phân tán một số con trai mình đi khắp các miền Giu-đa và Bên-gia-min, đến tất cả các thành kiên cố. Vua cấp cho họ lương thực dồi dào và tìm nhiều vợ cho họ.
vi.R: Rô-bô-am hành động khôn ngoan. Vua sai một số con trai mình đi khắp các vùng Giu-đa và Bên-gia-min, đến mọi thành kiên cố. Vua cấp cho họ nhiều lương thực, và xin nhiều vợ cho họ.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 지혜롭게 행하여, 그의 모든 아들 가운데 몇을 유다와 베냐민의 모든 지역, 곧 모든 요새 성읍에 흩어 두었다. 그리고 그들에게 양식을 넉넉히 주고, 많은 아내를 구했다.
ko.B: 그는 지혜롭게 처신하여, 아들들 가운데 몇을 유다와 베냐민 모든 지역의 요새 성읍마다 흩어 두었다. 그는 그들에게 양식을 넉넉히 주고, 그들을 위하여 많은 아내를 구해 주었다.
ko.R: 르호보암은 지혜롭게 행동했다. 그는 아들들 가운데 몇을 유다와 베냐민 모든 지역의 요새 성읍마다 보냈다. 그는 그들에게 필요한 것을 넉넉히 주었고, 그들을 위하여 많은 아내를 구해 주었다.

decisions.choice: acted wisely: acted with shrewd understanding
decisions.reason: The verb means to understand or to act with insight. Spreading his sons among the fortified cities gave them posts and support of their own and kept them apart from one another, which may have helped to prevent rivalry with Abijah (verse 22). The text does not explain the wisdom, so this purpose is not certain.

decisions.choice: some of all his sons
decisions.reason: The phrase "from all his sons" means some of them, not every one.

decisions.choice: sought many wives: for his sons
decisions.reason: The verse does not say for whom the wives were sought. Since it is about providing for his sons, it most likely means wives for them; it could also mean Rehoboam sought more wives for himself (verse 21).

decisions.choice: for them
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state the likely reading (m3); Literal keeps the Hebrew's open wording.

decisions.choice: districts; areas
decisions.reason: "Lands" here means the regions of the kingdom.
